text:
Jamie (Product): Quick breakout — ACME just asked for a private pilot with tightened launch criteria. They want: 99.95% uptime SLA, p95 latency <200ms for short prompts, customer-managed KMS/HSM, and 30d audit log retention. Can we scope and call out cross-team deps? :eyes:

Priya (Customer Success): They need this for a compliance demo in ~8 weeks. Willing to sign an MSA if we can show a reasonable path to SLA. High priority from their side.

Rajat (Eng-runtime): Short answer: latency target is achievable but depends on placement and warm cache. For p95 <200ms we should consider: dedicated pool, pinned model (quantized fp16 or int8), and tenant-level prewarm + KV cache seeding. Expect ~3 weeks runtime work to add per-tenant prewarm + safe rollout hooks.

Maya (Infra): Dedicated pools ok but infra tasks: instance selection (A10G vs A100), NIC tuning, VPC peering tests, and capacity reservations. Also need infra tickets for HSM network ACLs. Rough estimate: 2 weeks to provision/devtest once we have resource priority.

Luis (Security): KMS/HSM + audit retention will need design and compliance signoff. For pilot we can accept customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own) to reduce implementation time. Full HSM integration (customer hardware or HSM-as-a-service) is a larger project (2–3 sprints) for SOC2+ posture. Also we should run a quick threat model for data-in-transit/export controls.

Talia (Eng): We need model version pinning + controlled rollouts. Suggest canary -> ramp -> full with automatic fallback to a hosted variant if latency or error budgets breach. Also require metrics instrumentation for token-level latency.

Sam (SRE): We'll need a runbook, SLIs, and alerts tied to both latency and error budget. Who owns cost risk if the pilot spikes usage? Also recommend performance test harness before external demo.

Jamie (Product): Draft MVP scope proposal: 1) Dedicated tenant pool + prewarm; 2) Customer-managed KMS integration for pilot; 3) Model pin + canary rollout; 4) SLA doc + runbook + daily reports for customer. Target: 6 weeks to MVP (pilot-ready), contingent on infra/runtime prioritization. Thoughts?

Rajat (Eng-runtime): 6 weeks is optimistic but doable with prioritized resources. Need at least: 2 runtime engineers (3 if we want faster), 1 infra eng to provision/devtest, and security review slot. Also need a small perf harness (I can spin up a draft). Attaching a sample prewarm config we plan to support:

```
# per-tenant prewarm config (proposal)
prewarm:
  enabled: true
  concurrency: 4
  kv_seed_size: 32
  warm_duration: 900 # seconds
  fallback_on_error: true
```

Maya (Infra): We can allocate 1 infra eng but that will push other infra tickets. If Product flags this as "pilot priority" we can reassign. We'll need perf windows to validate p95 on chosen instance types. Also we'll require a small quota commit to avoid noisy neighbor impacts.

Luis (Security): For pilot, agree with BYOK KMS + strict RBAC and audit logging enabled. We'll need to capture audit events and retention policy in the SLA appendix. I'll schedule a 1-hour risk review.

Talia (Eng): Canary policy suggestion: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48 hours, with automated rollback if p95 increases by >25% or error rate >0.5%. Need owners for the monitoring thresholds.

Sam (SRE): I'll draft the runbook and alert thresholds. We should also define the rollback path (auto to hosted variant + notify customer).

Priya (Customer Success): ACME wants daily latency reports during the pilot and a single point of contact. They are comfortable with cost caps if we provide alerts at 50% and 80% of agreed budget.

Jamie (Product): Owners (proposed): Rajat — runtime implementation and canary; Maya — infra provisioning & perf validation; Luis — security review & KMS guidance; Sam — runbook/alerts; Priya — customer comms. Action items:
- Jamie: create JIRA epic + link deps and mark as "pilot-priority" (today)
- Rajat: prototype prewarm + perf harness (ETA 10 working days)
- Maya: reserve instance SKUs & test VPC peering (ETA 7 working days)
- Luis: schedule security risk review & KMS checklist (ETA 5 working days)
- Sam: start runbook draft and rollback plan (ETA 4 working days)
- Priya: confirm ACME budget cap + POC contact (ETA 2 working days)

Jamie (Product): Let's sync tomorrow 11:00am PT for quick alignment. If infra/runtime can hit the ETAs above we commit to the 6-week pilot timeline; otherwise we'll revise the scope (likely drop HSM and move to BYOK + extended SLA ramp). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder — please add the epic key to the product-channel when created.

Talia (Eng): Ok, adding that canary policy to the epic once created.

Rajat (Eng-runtime): I'll post the initial perf numbers to the thread once the harness is up.

Maya (Infra): Noted. I'll escalate resource allocation to infra lead if we need to hit the 6-week timeline.

Jamie (Product): Thanks all — meeting invite in 10 minutes.
